pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   B. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   B. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam .

8. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   B. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.
   C. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.
   B. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Use Shirk of Shirk Shirk to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Shirk of Shirk Shirk and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat and Zakatul Fitr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
